title: Slope interval
statement:
The bootstrap 95% CI for the true slope is (−0.4, 1.1). What should you conclude?

[_]{a}

choices: Use a 99% interval to get a significant result
0 is plausible, so the linear relation may not be real
explanations: A wider interval would still include 0.

solution: Because the interval contains 0, the true line could be flat.
